newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: Swiss, EU sign deal to boost customs control.
newsitem.headline: Swiss, EU sign deal to boost customs control.

text.p: Switzerland and the European Union on Monday signed an agreement to cooperate more closely on customs control.

The agreement, due to take effect on July 1, allows authorities to exchange more information and gives them additional powers in the fight against smuggling, including allowing individuals or companies to be put under surveillance, the Swiss customs authority said in a statement.
The deal is in the form of an additional protocol to the 1972 free trade accord between Switzerland and the European Community.
"The agreement means a substantial improvement of surveillance mechanisms in the free trade accord," the statement said.
